name: El Incumplimiento de Contrato
description: Simulation to teach contract breach remediation, damage calculation, and the strategic tradeoff between litigation and negotiated settlement in a Colombian construction context

📋Round 1 — Damage Assessment
Constructora Cumbrera contracted Cementera del Calizal for 2,000 tons of cement (COP 800M). Only 800 tons were delivered. 120 workers are idle. Calculate direct damages (idle worker cost per month × 2 months) and indirect damages (penalties with the final client).

Your Decisions

120 workers × avg. salary. Consider total monthly payroll.
Review the contract penalty clause for delays.
